// Go regexp test data: Copyright 2009 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Extraction for Pulse, 2026. Original license: adjacent Go-LICENSE.
// No upstream runtime code or Pulse-derived expectations are used.
// Reproduce: go run producer.go /path/to/go1.27.3/src/regexp/all_test.go
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Row struct {
	Table       string `json:"table"`
	Line        int    `json:"line"`
	Pattern     string `json:"pattern"`
	Replacement string `json:"replacement"`
	Input       string `json:"input"`
	Output      string `json:"output"`
	Literal     bool   `json:"literal"`
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("expected pinned Go regexp/all_test.go")
	}
	source, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256(source)
	if hex.EncodeToString(hash[:]) != "caffaf144a8db14a7fd0476f8cc4ba51dba750f3b3f32e26cfee6629ee33057c" {
		panic("pinned source hash mismatch")
	}
	positions := token.NewFileSet()
	file, err := parser.ParseFile(positions, "all_test.go", source, 0)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	rows := []Row{}
	for _, declaration := range file.Decls {
		general, ok := declaration.(*ast.GenDecl)
		if !ok || general.Tok != token.VAR {
			continue
		}
		for _, specification := range general.Specs {
			value := specification.(*ast.ValueSpec)
			name := value.Names[0].Name
			if name != "replaceTests" && name != "replaceLiteralTests" {
				continue
			}
			for _, expression := range value.Values[0].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
				entry := expression.(*ast.CompositeLit)
				fields := make([]string, 4)
				for i, field := range entry.Elts {
					fields[i], err = strconv.Unquote(field.(*ast.BasicLit).Value)
					if err != nil {
						panic(err)
					}
				}
				row := Row{Table: name, Line: positions.Position(entry.Pos()).Line,
					Pattern: fields[0], Replacement: fields[1], Input: fields[2], Output: fields[3],
					Literal: name == "replaceLiteralTests"}
				rows = append(rows, row)
				// Preserve the upstream literal harness's additional replay of
				// every expanded-mode row without dollar substitutions.
				if !row.Literal && !strings.Contains(row.Replacement, "$") {
					row.Literal = true
					rows = append(rows, row)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		panic("missing original test tables")
	}
	out := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	out.SetIndent("", "  ")
	out.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	if err := out.Encode(struct {
		Source string `json:"source"`
		SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
		Rows   []Row  `json:"rows"`
	}{"https://github.com/golang/go/blob/go1.27.3/src/regexp/all_test.go", fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash), rows}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
